chapter_title_en: A Sudden Encounter at the Spirit Spring
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 504: Han Li’s Unexpected Bath Scene at the Spirit Eye Spring
chapter_meta_description: Han Li finds a hidden teleportation array and ends up in a secret Spirit Eye Spring—right where a naked Yuan Yao is bathing. Tension, seduction, and a precious treasure collide in this unforgettable chapter.
og_title: RMJI Ch 504: Han Meets Yuan Yao at the Spirit Eye Spring
og_description: When a quiet exploration turns into the most awkward bath encounter of Han Li’s life, he learns that even embarrassment is a resource in the cultivation world.
twitter_description: Han Li teleports into a secret Spirit Eye Spring and finds Yuan Yao naked. Let the social calculations begin.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare concentration of pure spiritual qi that manifests as a pool of liquid energy. Meditating near one can accelerate cultivation speed by 20-30%.
A formation inscribed with runes that instantly transports a cultivator from one location to another, usually consuming spirit stones as fuel.
The inner palace of the Heavenvoid Palace, a dungeon-level trial zone in the Chaotic Star Sea arc.
A beautiful rogue cultivator from the Chaotic Star Sea, known for her sharp mind and talent for negotiation; a survivor above all else.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn’t Han Li look away immediately?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In the Mortal Stream, information is everything. He uses the moment to assess her state, her resources, and any immediate threat or opportunity.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a Spirit Eye Spring?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s a rare concentration of pure spiritual qi manifesting as a pool of liquid energy. Meditating near one can boost cultivation speed by 20-30%.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the green jade bottle important?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It likely contains something from the spring’s origin (the dragon-head carving). Yuan Yao’s speed in reclaiming it suggests it’s a high-value, portable asset.
Not in the conventional sense. It’s a tense social negotiation where both sides use charm and distraction as tactical tools while evaluating each other’s intentions.
